paper.title: Residual Momentum
paper.read_scope: Introduction; section 3 pp 9-13 including equation 1, alpha paragraph and footnotes; section 5.5 pp 34-35 (complete-history matched control). Other complete results/robustness not claimed read.
paper.method_interpretation: Intercept fitted in OLS, but factor-only subtraction for rank returns follows the explicit alpha paragraph; rank return differs from full regression error
paper.replication_limit: Original long-short CRSP deciles and multiple overlapping holding periods not reproduced; pure long high-beta constraints and factor lag are DX27 extensions

factor_sources.read_scope: FF3 factor and RF definitions; RF source changes June 2024
2025 FIZ to CIZ switch; monthly dividend-reinvestment construction difference and CSV download link

arithmetic_limits: Paper prose does not fully specify machine arithmetic for summing adjusted returns or ddof; RM1 freezes additive sum and sample sd as an implementation convention, not a verified author-code replication.
claims: Published long-short performance is not transferred to this study; score is not proven alpha and pure long portfolio is not factor neutral
